derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G5258 (ὕπνος);
def: properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber

occurrences.text: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
